pages.title: VRRCTW | 社群規範 Community Guidelines
pages.description: VRRCTW VR Racing Club 社群規範：尊重玩家、公平競爭、投稿與排行榜驗證方式，以及管理處理原則。
pages.text: 星河 STARRIVER ARTS ProjectT 世界 Worlds VRRCTW 規範 Guidelines Racing Hub 賽事中心 Racing Hub VRC VRRCTW / 社群規範 VRRCTW / Community Guidelines 社群規範 Community Guidelines 我們希望這裡是一個能自在聊天、開車、交流技術，也能認真挑戰成績的地方。競賽難免有碰撞，交流也難免有不同意見；我們不期待每個人都完全一致，但希望每個人都能尊重其他玩家，也不要讓自己的行為妨礙別人參與社群。 We want this to be a place where people can hang out, drive, share knowledge, and seriously challenge their own lap times. Racing naturally involves mistakes and contact, and people will not always agree with each other. We do not expect everyone to get along perfectly, but we do expect everyone to respect other players and avoid interfering with their ability to participate in the community. 01 尊重其他玩家 Respect Other Players 請不要持續騷擾、威脅、惡意羞辱、冒充或針對特定玩家。 Do not repeatedly harass, threaten, maliciously insult, impersonate, or target other players. 意見不同、技術討論、玩笑或一時的情緒並不會自動構成違規；管理上會特別考量行為是否具有持續性、惡意，以及是否實際影響他人。 Disagreements, technical discussions, jokes, and occasional frustration are not automatically violations. When reviewing an incident, we primarily consider whether the behavior was persistent, malicious, or had a meaningful impact on others. 02 不要破壞別人的遊戲與活動 Do Not Disrupt Other Players or Events 正常失誤、碰撞或駕駛技術不足都是遊戲的一部分。 Driving mistakes, crashes, and lack of driving skill are normal parts of the game. 但請不要故意撞擊、堵塞賽道、干擾起跑或計時、持續妨礙活動進行，或利用 Avatar、Client、漏洞及其他方式破壞他人的遊戲體驗。 However, do not intentionally ram other players, block the course, interfere with starts or timing sessions, repeatedly disrupt events, or use Avatars, clients, exploits, or other methods to interfere with other players' experience. 正式活動進行時，請配合當次公布的車輛、起跑、賽道與房間管理規則。 During organized events, please follow any vehicle, starting procedure, course, or instance rules announced for that event. 03 公平競爭 Fair Competition 參加計時、排行榜或正式競賽時，不得使用未經允許的方式改變車輛性能、物理、計時結果或取得其他不公平優勢。 During time attacks, leaderboard runs, or organized competition, players must not use unauthorized methods to alter vehicle performance, physics, timing results, or otherwise gain an unfair competitive advantage. 特殊車輛、改裝或特殊玩法若為當次活動明確允許，則不受此限。 Special vehicles, modifications, or unusual gameplay mechanics are allowed when they are explicitly permitted by the event. pages.title: VRRCTW｜VRChat 賽車社群｜ProjectT
pages.description: VRRCTW 是中文圈主要的 VRChat 賽車社群，提供賽車活動、日常車聚、Time Attack 紀錄與駕駛技術交流。
pages.text: 星河 STARRIVER ARTS ProjectT 世界 Worlds VRRCTW 規範 Guidelines Racing Hub 賽事中心 Racing Hub VRC ProjectT / VRChat 賽車社群 ProjectT / VRChat racing community VRRCTW 中文圈主要的 VRChat 賽車社群，連結喜歡駕駛的玩家、世界創作者與車輛作者，提供賽車活動、日常車聚、Time Attack 紀錄與駕駛技術交流。 A leading Chinese-language VRChat racing community connecting drivers, world creators and vehicle creators through races, casual meets, Time Attack records and driving discussion. 加入 Discord Join Discord VRChat Group Racing Hub 賽事中心 Racing Hub 想來就來，尊重賽程，也尊重一起開車的人。 Drop in, respect the session, and respect the people driving with you. 比賽與日常車聚目前不需事前報名。玩家可依活動公告進入指定的 VRChat Group Instance；可以自由進出活動房間，但請勿干擾世界運作、擅自進入正在使用的賽道，或插入已開始的正式賽程。 Races and casual meets currently require no advance registration. Join the announced VRChat Group Instance, but do not disrupt the world, enter an active course, or insert yourself into a race already in progress. Join 三個入口，各自負責不同事情 Three entry points, three roles Primary community Discord 主要訊息社群平台，也是目前唯一的 Time Attack 投稿入口。查看公告、交流駕駛技術、討論方向盤等控制輸入，並分享活動與攝影。 The main community and the only current Time Attack submission channel. Find announcements, driving discussion, controller setup and photography. 優先加入 Join first In VRChat VRRCTW.2777 在 VRChat 內接收活動通知、查看群組房間，並直接加入其他賽車手。 Receive event notifications in VRChat, browse group instances and join other racers directly. Open Group Data platform Racing Hub 賽事中心 Racing Hub 查詢世界與賽道、玩家與車輛紀錄、世界連結，以及活動時間與地點，作為挑戰下一筆紀錄的依據。 Browse worlds, tracks, player and vehicle records, world links, and event details as a basis for your next challenge. 查看紀錄 View records Community standard 基本規則 Basic standard 請互相尊重他人，遵守秩序，維持運動家精神。完整的社群規範（尊重玩家、公平競爭、投稿與排行榜驗證方式、管理處理原則）請見下方連結。 Respect others, follow the session order, and maintain good sportsmanship. See the full community guidelines below for details on respecting players, fair competition, submission/leaderboard verification, and how moderation works. 查看完整社群規範 Read the full guidelines Season format 賽季與日常活動 Seasons and regular meets VRRCTW 以半年為一個賽季，每季通常安排五至六輪，每輪包含 Sacc 與 CVS 兩場比賽，合計約十至十二場。活動原則上每月舉辦；實際日期、場地、車輛指定或限制與規則，以當期公告為準。 VRRCTW generally runs a half-year season with five to six rounds. pages.title: ProjectT｜臺灣 VRChat 賽車社群與世界創作計畫
pages.description: ProjectT 是一項以臺灣為出發點的 VRChat 賽車社群計畫，結合臺灣公路與賽車地景創作、中文賽車社群、賽事及計時紀錄，以及可供不同 VRChat 世界使用的通用賽事工具。
pages.text: 跳到主要內容 Skip to content 星河 STARRIVER ARTS 總覽 Overview ProjectT Worlds VRRCTW Racing 工具組 Toolkit ProjectT Taiwan Touge Project 臺灣山道計畫 在臺灣山道駕駛、相約車聚，或挑戰一圈更快的成績。 Drive Taiwan-inspired roads, meet other drivers, or chase a faster lap in VRChat. 找個世界上路 Find a world to drive 參加活動 Join Events 從這裡開始 Start here 駕駛、相聚、挑戰 Drive, meet, compete 找一段山路自己練習，也可以和社群一起參加車聚與賽事。跑完之後，到 Racing Hub 看看自己的成績。 Choose a road for practice, or join the community for meets and races. After a run, explore your times in Racing Hub. Worlds ProjectT Worlds 從觀星山的短程下坡，到九彎十八拐的宜蘭山道，選一個世界開始駕駛。 Start with StarSight’s short downhill run or the Yilan mountain road of 9 Turns. 查看世界 Explore Worlds Community VRRCTW 和中文圈的 VRChat 玩家交流駕駛、參加車聚，或一起投入 Sacc 與 CVS 賽事。 Meet Chinese-speaking VRChat drivers, exchange driving tips, and join Sacc and CVS events. 進入社群 Enter Community Data & Records Racing Hub 賽事中心 查詢路線最快成績，看看不同車輛的表現，或找到玩家與賽事的紀錄。 Explore the fastest route times, compare vehicles, and find player records and event results. 開啟 Racing Hub 賽事中心 Open Racing Hub 給世界作者與活動主辦者 For creators & organizers VRChat Racing Toolkit 把計時榜與賽事資訊帶進 VRChat 世界。想在自己的世界或活動中使用，歡迎先向社群詢問。 Bring leaderboards and racing information into a VRChat world. Both worlds are open on PC and Quest. PC + Quest · CVS 觀星山 StarSight Mt. 穿過虛構臺灣山景中的短程下坡，從彎道與隧道之間找到自己的駕駛節奏。這裡也是 VRRCTW 的聚會據點。 Find your rhythm through bends and tunnels on a short downhill road in a fictional Taiwanese landscape. StarSight is also a VRRCTW gathering place. 進入觀星山 Visit StarSight 查看下行成績 Downhill records 認識這件作品 About the work PC + Quest · CVS2 / Sacc 九彎十八拐 9 Turns 以臺 9 線石牌至頭城段為基礎，沿著宜蘭山道的連續彎線前行。可選擇 CVS2 或 Sacc 版本駕駛。 Follow the bends of a Yilan mountain road based on Highway 9 from Shipai to Toucheng. pages.title: Studio | StarRiver Arts
pages.description: StarRiver Arts 的精選作品與專業能力：VR 應用設計、景觀地景建模與數位策展規劃。
pages.text: 跳到主要內容 Skip to content 星河 STARRIVER ARTS 工作室 Studio ProjectT Museum VR 數位體驗 · 臺灣 VR Digital Experiences · Taiwan 星河 StarRiver Arts 以 VR 應用設計、景觀地景建模與數位策展規劃，將地景與知識轉譯為可進入的數位體驗。 Designing VR applications, modeled landscapes, and digitally curated experiences that turn place and knowledge into spaces people can enter. 01 · 作品 01 · Projects Beyond Gravity 天鉤太空站科普展示世界。VRChat Space Jam 3 參賽作品。耗時兩周。 Skyhook space station science exhibition. pages.description: 觀察距離、光線、材質與標識，如何影響我們觀看作品的方式。
pages.text: StarRiver Arts / Museum / Web Exhibitions / VR Gallery Spatial System EN 中文 Museum · Web Exhibition VR Gallery Spatial System 距離、光線與標識，如何改變我們觀看作品的方式？ How do distance, light, and signs shape the way we see a work? I · Spatial System 01 Colour 色彩 02 Materials 材質 03 Ergonomics 空間人因 04 Whitespace 留白 05 Reserves 預留量體 06 Curves 曲線幾何 07 Plans & Elev. 平立面 08 Lighting 光源 09 Virtual Effects 虛擬效果 II · Typography 10 Typography 字排 11 Signage System 標識系統 I Spatial Design System 空間設計系統 01 Colour 色彩角色 同一種顏色，換了光源就可能有不同的樣貌。比較色溫與照明，觀察顏色如何改變。 The same colour can look different under another light. Compare lighting and colour temperature to see what changes. Palette · Roles 四角色色票 Role Semantics 角色語意 Target → Actual 目標 vs 實際 Light Temperature 光源色溫 02 Materials 材質 從霧面到亮面，觀察材質如何接住、散開或反射光線。 From matte to glossy, explore how surfaces catch, scatter, and reflect light. Materials · Matte 霧面 Satin & Glossy 緞面・亮面 Material × Light 材質 × 光源 Shaders · Recommendations 著色器建議 03 Spatial Ergonomics 空間人因 作品掛在多高、隔多遠，才能看得舒服？比較視線高度、觀看角度與通行的空間。 How high should a work hang, and how far away should you stand? Compare eye level, viewing angles, and room to move. 130 cm Avatar Avatar 基準 Viewing Distance 視距 Viewing Cone 視錐 Mounting Height 安裝高度 Fan Corridors + Liminal 扇形走廊・邊界空間 Non-Rectangular Spaces 非矩形空間 04 Whitespace as Structure 留白即結構 作品之間的空白也影響觀看。留意間距與排列，如何讓視線停留或繼續前進。 The space between works matters too. Notice how spacing and grouping invite the eye to pause or move on. Inter-Exhibit Spacing 展品間距 Grouping Rhythm 群組節奏 05 Exhibit Reserve Volumes 展品預留量體 比較大小不同的作品需要多少周邊空間，留意觀看與通行是否互相干擾。 Compare the space needed around works of different sizes, and how viewing and movement share that space. Reserves Overview S/M/L/XL 總覽 Reserve Validation 視錐驗證 06 Curve Geometry 曲線幾何 壁龕、隔板與基座的弧度，會如何改變空間的輪廓？比較不同半徑的轉折。 How do curved niches, partitions, and plinths shape a room? Compare bends of different radii. Curve Radii · Approved Set 核可曲線半徑 07 Plans & Elevations 平面圖・立面圖 換成俯視或側視，展牆、作品與視線之間的關係會變得更清楚。 Looking from above or from the side reveals how walls, works, and sightlines relate. Plan View Sample 平面圖範例 Elevation Sample 立面圖範例 08 Lighting 光源系統 光可以讓作品從背景中浮現，也能改變空間的氣氛。觀察多個光源交會時的變化。 Light can draw a work out of its surrounding…
